title: Unit compatibility of transported Picard pullback composition
statement: Let X,Y,Z be schemes [def-pc-scheme], k:Z→Y and l:Y→X. Use tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], its unit comparison u [def-sc-picard-cup-product-map] and composition comparison c [lem-sc-picard-canonical-base-change-comparisons]. Then P_k(u_l) followed by u_k equals c_(O_X) followed by u_(k followed by l), exactly as lean.statement. No tensor pair or pairing appears.

source.place: Definition 6.26.1(2), tensor formula; Tag 0096, adjunction normalizing the composition comparison. Expanded tensor/unit-composition argument of lem-sc-picard-pairing-composition.

proof.text: For the ordinary inverse unit-composition equation, use unit_hom_ext to reduce maps from O_Z to evaluation at 1 on the top open. Use pullbackSection_one_eq, pullbackSection_pullbackSection and pullbackUnit_naturality_apply to identify both values. Iso.ext_inv gives the forward equation. These are the existing proved declarations in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.HomSection and PullbackUnit.

Expand Picard unit and composition comparisons, use naturality of picardTensorComparison k at the ordinary unit map for l, apply the proved ordinary unit equation and cancel the comparison inverse/hom at the composite.

lean.statement:
theorem picardTensorUnitIso_comp
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Z ⟶ Y) (l : Y ⟶ X) :
    (tensorPullback k).map (picardTensorUnitIso l).hom ≫
      (picardTensorUnitIso k).hom =
    (picardTensorCompIso k l (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).hom ≫
      (picardTensorUnitIso (k ≫ l)).hom
